purpose: Static mine artwork proposals for owner selection; not final runtime sprites or animation frames

options.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: proposal painting sheet for three original fantasy strategy overworld resource sites for Aurelion Reach. Create a polished landscape 3-column concept sheet showing three separate detailed game sprites side by side, consistent 3/4 oblique elevated camera, orthographic projection, front facing toward bottom of frame. LEFT WOOD sawmill, CENTER ORE mine, RIGHT GOLD mine. Every building must occupy a compact wide rectangular ground footprint THREE TILES WIDE by TWO TILES DEEP (3:2 ground proportion), similar overall size, with a clear front-center accessible entrance. They should look substantial at overworld scale. Hand-painted raster game art, crisp silhouettes, weathered material detail, restrained realistic medieval fantasy colors, NOT cartoon, NOT low-poly, NOT icon/vector art, no modern equipment, no characters. Individual machines should be large enough to read and animate, but structures remain grounded. Biome independent: neutral gray/tan stone and weathered timber foundations, no grass/snow/sand or colored ground plates, no water or surrounding landscape; tightly contained natural contact shadows. All three on uniform pale warm-gray presentation background with broad clean gutters and NO decorative frame. Entire objects visible, no cropping. This is a STATIC concept proposal, not an animation or spritesheet. Small clear heading at top with option name; labels beneath each object exactly WOOD, ORE, GOLD. No income labels, no other text, no watermark. These must be original designs, not copies of any existing game's assets. Heading exactly "A · TIMBER WORKYARDS". Practical rugged timber industry. WOOD: broad open-sided timber sawmill, muted charcoal shingle roof, prominent exposed metal flywheel driving a horizontal log saw, one long log on cutting carriage, tidy low cut-plank stack. No waterwheel (must work away from rivers). ORE: squared timber-framed horizontal mine entrance built into a very LOW neutral gray rock outcrop, short rails and ore cart centered at front, exposed hand-cranked winch and timber headframe at side, dark blue-gray ore. GOLD: stout timber-braced shaft house with muted ochre roofing, raised bucket hoist and large winding drum, compact stone sorting bench with a few warm gold glints, one warm lantern. Visually distinguish the ore cart from the gold hoist at a glance. Low supporting rocks, no tall surrounding mountain.
